summary_1line: Despite prophecy of Satyavan’s death within a year, Savitri marries him and joins his exiled family in the forest, serving them with devotion.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narada solemnly tells the court that the virtuous prince Satyavan will die within a year while Savitri stands resolute beside her father.
In a forest hermitage beneath a sala tree, the blind king Dyumatsena sits on kusa grass as Aswapati offers his daughter Savitri in marriage to Satyavan.
Savitri removes her royal ornaments and dons simple bark garments in the forest, beginning her life of service beside Satyavan’s ascetic family.
